preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree must be between 1 and 10^9.
The number of extra edges must be between 0 and 4.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in extra_edges)
preconditions.description: Each extra edge must connect two distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of simple paths in the resulting graph, modulo 10^9 + 7.
